doc: Sample mailbox of the DEMO STACK only (DemoImapGateway, active only when DEMO_ENABLED is on and the prod profile is not). Every value here is a test value: the address is the one demo address the sandbox accepts, any 16-letter code connects to it, a code that starts with 'zzzz' is refused as a wrong password and one that starts with 'yyyy' as 'Gmail wants an app password'. Nothing in this file ever reaches a real Gmail. Dates are days before the moment of reading.
